title: FRE 611(a), (c) · examination
text: The court controls examination. Leading questions are ordinarily allowed on cross-examination and ordinarily restricted on direct, with exceptions.

title: FRE 602 · personal knowledge
text: A witness generally needs personal knowledge; expert testimony has separate rules. Ask what the witness personally perceived before alleging speculation.

title: FRE 801–807 · hearsay
text: Hearsay involves an out-of-court statement offered for its truth. Check nonhearsay uses, exclusions (including opposing-party statements), and applicable exceptions before objecting.

title: FRE 901–902 · authentication
text: Authentication requires sufficient support that an item is what its proponent claims. Some items are self-authenticating. Mentioning an exhibit alone establishes no authentication defect.

title: FRE 1002–1004 · originals and duplicates
text: The original requirement concerns proving content. Duplicates are generally admissible, subject to authenticity or fairness concerns; other exceptions also apply.

title: FRE 401–403 · relevance
text: Relevance concerns consequential facts. Rule 403 balancing requires substantially outweighing probative value with specified dangers, including unfair prejudice; damaging evidence alone is insufficient.
